title: Time
part1: Do you spend a lot of time with your family or relatives?
Do you prefer to hang out with old friends or make new friends?
How often do you do exercise or play sports to keep fit?
Do you like to make a to-do list to plan your things in advance?
cue: Describe a free-time activity that you enjoy doing.
say: What the activity is
How often you do it
Who you usually do it with
explain: And explain why you enjoy doing this activity in your free time.

title: Inside outside (Street life & Home life)
part1: Is the nightlife in your town or city lively or dull?
Do you think there is a huge problem with rubbish in your city centre?
What is your favourite room in your home?
Do you prefer living in a house or a flat?
cue: Describe a street or a pedestrian area in your town that you know well.
say: Where it is
What kinds of shops or stalls are there
What people do there
explain: And explain why you think this is a safe or interesting place to visit.

title: Stories (Past events & Adverbs of manner)
part1: Do you usually make important life decisions quickly or slowly?
How do you feel when you have to speak in front of a large group of people?
Can you easily start a short conversation with a stranger on a bus or train?
When was the last time you felt very excited about a special event?
cue: Describe a memorable experience or a funny thing that happened to you in the past.
say: When and where it happened
What you were doing at that time
What went wrong or happened in the end
explain: And explain how you felt during this experience.

title: Changes (Life stages, Internet & Future plans)
part1: Do you want to live or work abroad in the future?
How much time do you spend online using social media every day?
Are you going to check your emails right after this class finishes?
Do you find it easy or difficult to give up a bad habit?
cue: Describe a future plan or arrangement you have made for a special event.
say: What the event or plan is
When and where it is going to happen
Who is going to go with you
explain: And explain why you are looking forward to this future plan.

title: Stuff and things (Objects, Money & Quantifiers)
part1: What is an ordinary personal possession that you use every day?
Do you prefer to buy things online or look for them in real shops?
Do you carry a lot of cash and coins in your wallet or purse?
Do you enjoy spending money on fashionable clothes?
cue: Describe a special object or a valuable possession that you own.
say: What it looks like and what material it is made of
Who gave it to you or where you got it from
What you use it for
explain: And explain why this possession is so important or special to you.

title: Local art and crafts
part1: Do you like buying traditional handmade items?
Are there any famous crafts made in your hometown?
Do you prefer to decorate your home with modern things or traditional objects?
Did you learn how to make any arts or crafts when you were a child?
cue: Describe a traditional handmade object from your country.
say: What the object is
What it is made of
How people make it
explain: And explain why this traditional craft is important to your culture.

title: City transport and commuting
part1: How do you usually travel to work or study every day?
Do you think public transport in your city is expensive?
Is traffic a big problem in the area where you live?
Do you prefer driving a car or riding a bicycle in the city?
cue: Describe a journey you took on public transport that you remember well.
say: Where you were going
What kind of transport you used
Who you travelled with
explain: And explain how you felt about this journey.

title: Weather and climate
part1: What is your favourite kind of weather?
Does the weather affect your mood or how you feel?
What do you usually do when it rains heavily outside?
Is the climate in your country changing compared to the past?
cue: Describe a time when extreme weather changed your outdoor plans.
say: When it happened
What the weather was like
What you planned to do
explain: And explain what you did instead because of the weather.

title: Architecture and local buildings
part1: Do you prefer living in a modern building or an old building?
What is the most beautiful building in your town or city?
Do you think it is important to protect historical buildings?
Would you like to design your own house in the future?
cue: Describe an interesting building in your town or city that you visited.
say: Where the building is
What it looks like from the outside
What people use this building for
explain: And explain why you find this building interesting.

title: Shopping and local markets
part1: Do you enjoy shopping at local street markets?
Is it better to buy fresh food from a market or a big supermarket?
How often do you go shopping for clothes?
Do you like to bargain for a lower price when you buy things?
cue: Describe a popular outdoor market that you know.
say: Where the market is
What kinds of things people sell there
When it is usually busy
explain: And explain why you like or dislike shopping at this market.

title: Memorable journeys and travel experiences
part1: Do you prefer to travel by train or by airplane when you go on holiday?
How often do you visit new places outside your hometown?
Do you like packing your bags a long time before a trip?
What is the most beautiful place you have ever visited?
cue: Describe a memorable trip you took with your friends or family.
say: Where you went on this trip
Who you travelled with
What activities you did during the trip
explain: And explain why this travel experience was so memorable to you.

title: Family history and childhood memories
part1: Did you spend a lot of time with your grandparents when you were a child?
Do your parents often tell you stories about their own childhood?
What was your favourite game to play when you were young?
Do you think it is important to collect old family photographs?
cue: Describe a happy memory from your childhood days.
say: How old you were at that time
Where you were when this happened
What exactly happened during this event
explain: And explain why you still feel happy when you remember this childhood moment.

title: Traditional celebrations and festivals
part1: What is the most important traditional holiday in your country?
Do you prefer staying at home or going out during major festivals?
What kind of special food does your family prepare for celebrations?
Do people wear traditional clothes during holidays in your town?
cue: Describe a traditional festival or celebration that you enjoyed recently.
say: What kind of festival it was
Who you celebrated it with
What activities people did during the day
explain: And explain why you enjoyed participating in this traditional celebration.

title: Inspiring books and life-changing stories
part1: Do you enjoy reading books or do you prefer watching movies?
How often did your teachers read stories to you at school?
Do you like receiving books as gifts for your birthday?
What is the title of the last book or story you read?
cue: Describe an interesting book or story that you read in the past.
say: What the title of the book or story was
What the main topic or story was about
Where you first found or bought this book
explain: And explain why you think this book or story was so interesting to read.

title: Personal achievements and success
part1: What is a small daily goal that you try to achieve every morning?
Do you feel proud when you learn a difficult new skill?
Who is the most successful person that you know personally?
Do you like setting big goals for your future career or study?
cue: Describe an important personal success or achievement in your life.
say: What you successfully achieved
When and where you completed this goal
How hard you had to work to achieve it
explain: And explain how you felt after you achieved this success.

title: Technology and future lifestyle
part1: Do you use smart gadgets to help you with your daily chores?
Do you think robots will do most of the housework in the future?
How often do you buy new electronic products or devices?
Do you like using technology to learn new things online?
cue: Describe a piece of technology that you want to buy in the future.
say: What kind of technology it is
When you plan to buy it
What features you will use the most
explain: And explain why this piece of technology will change your lifestyle.

title: Environmental changes and green living
part1: Do you try to recycle plastic bottles and paper at home?
Is there enough green space or parks in your local neighborhood?
Do you prefer to walk or cycle instead of taking a car to protect the air?
Do you think young people care a lot about saving energy?
cue: Describe an environmentally friendly habit that you started recently.
say: What the habit is
How often you do it
Who helps you to keep this habit
explain: And explain why you think this change is good for the environment.

title: Life stages and personal growth
part1: What is the most exciting age for a person in your country?
Do you think people become wiser as they get older?
What important skill did you learn when you became an adult?
Do you like to celebrate your birthday with a big party every year?
cue: Describe an important change or transition that happened in your life.
say: When this change happened
How your daily routine changed after it
What challenges you faced during this time
explain: And explain why this was an important stage for your personal growth.

title: Future careers and work life
part1: What kind of job do you hope to do in five years?
Do you prefer to work alone or as part of a big team?
Is it common for people in your country to change their jobs often?
Would you like to start your own business or work for a company?
cue: Describe a career or a job that you would like to have in the future.
say: What the job is
What qualifications or skills you need for it
Where you would like to work
explain: And explain why you think this career path will be satisfying for you.

title: Global travel and cultural changes
part1: Do you want to visit a country that has a completely different culture from yours?
Do you think international tourism changes the local traditions of a place?
What foreign language would you like to learn fluently in the future?
Do you enjoy trying traditional food from other countries?
cue: Describe a foreign country that you plan to visit for a holiday.
say: Where this country is located
When you are going to travel there
What cultural activities you want to experience there
explain: And explain why you chose this specific country for your future trip.

title: Personal belongings and valuable objects
part1: What is the most useful object that you carry with you every day?
Do you like keeping old things that have personal memories?
Is it easy for you to lose important things like your keys or phone?
Do you prefer to buy expensive items or cheap items?
cue: Describe an important object that you own.
say: What the object looks like
How long you have owned it
What you use it for
explain: And explain why this personal possession is valuable to you.

title: Money management and spending habits
part1: Do you think it is easy to save money every month?
What do you spend most of your money on?
Do you prefer to pay with cash or a bank card when you buy things?
Did your parents teach you how to manage your money when you were younger?
cue: Describe something expensive that you bought recently.
say: What you bought
Where you bought it from
Why you decided to buy it
explain: And explain how you felt after spending your money on this item.

title: Gifts and giving items to others
part1: Do you enjoy choosing gifts for your friends on their birthdays?
What was the best gift that you received last year?
Do you prefer giving gifts or receiving gifts?
Is it common to give money as a present in your country?
cue: Describe a special gift that you gave to someone else.
say: Who you gave the gift to
What the gift was
Why you chose this specific item
explain: And explain how the person reacted when they opened your gift.

title: Collecting things and hobbies
part1: Did you collect anything like stamps or stickers when you were a child?
Do you know anyone who collects unusual things?
Why do you think some people enjoy collecting old items?
Would you like to start a new collection or hobby in the future?
cue: Describe a collection of objects that you or someone you know has.
say: What the objects are
How many items are in the collection
Where the items are kept
explain: And explain why this collection is interesting to look at.

title: Advertising and unwanted things
part1: Do you often watch advertisements online or on television?
Have you ever bought something because of an interesting advertisement?
What do you do with things that you do not need anymore?
Do you like recycling old items to make something new?
cue: Describe a time when you bought something that you did not actually need.
say: What the item was
Why you decided to buy it at that moment
Where you put it after you bought it
explain: And explain why you regret buying this unwanted item.

title: Health, fitness and active lifestyles
part1: Do you try to eat healthy food every day?
How often do you go for a walk to get some fresh air?
Do you prefer playing team sports or exercising alone?
Is it easy for you to wake up early in the morning?
cue: Describe a sport or physical activity that you enjoy doing.
say: What the activity is
How often you do it
Where you usually do it
explain: And explain why this activity helps you stay healthy and fit.

title: Food, cooking and traditional dishes
part1: Do you enjoy cooking meals for your family or friends?
What is your favourite dish from your country?
Do you prefer eating at home or going to restaurants?
How often do you try new types of food?
cue: Describe a special meal or traditional dish that you know how to make.
say: What the dish is
What ingredients you need to prepare it
Who taught you how to cook it
explain: And explain why people in your country love this special food.

title: Daily habits and morning routines
part1: What is the first thing you do when you wake up?
Do you spend a lot of time preparing for your day in the morning?
Do you prefer a busy daily routine or a relaxed one?
Is your routine at the weekend different from your routine on weekdays?
cue: Describe a perfect morning routine that you would like to have.
say: What time you would wake up
What activities you would do first
What you would eat for breakfast
explain: And explain why this morning routine would make you feel good.

title: Leisure time and weekend entertainment
part1: What do you like to do on a Saturday afternoon?
Do you prefer staying indoors or going outside during your free time?
How often do you watch movies or television shows on weekends?
Who do you usually spend your free time with?
cue: Describe an enjoyable weekend activity that you did recently.
say: What the activity was
Where you went to do it
Who was with you at that time
explain: And explain why you found this weekend activity so enjoyable.

title: Healthy minds and managing stress
part1: What do you do to relax after a long day of work or study?
Do you think listening to music helps you feel calm?
Is it easy for you to fall asleep when you feel tired?
Do you like spending time alone when you need to think?
cue: Describe a quiet place where you go when you want to relax.
say: Where this place is located
What it looks like
What you usually do when you are there
explain: And explain why this place helps you feel peaceful and stress-free.
